title: Dylan Raiola throws a 31-yard touchdown pass to Dakorien Moore
text:
Watch Dylan Raiola throws a 31-yard touchdown pass to Dakorien Moore - FOX | FOX One Skip to main content arrow-left button Sign up for FOX One today! Dylan Raiola throws a 31-yard touchdown pass to Dakorien Moore
 FOX · Aired Today · 17s 
 Watch Now Already a subscriber? Sign-In During the fourth quarter of the game, Oregon Ducks quarterback Dylan Raiola drops back and unloads a perfect 31-yard touchdown pass into the end zone. Wide receiver Dakorien Moore makes an acrobatic catch on the run, securing the touchdown to extend Oregon's lead over Michigan State.
